_source: Measured by hand on the owner's Korean client screenshots, 1920×1009 windowed (M91 shop set, M95 run set, local-fixtures/, not committed). Regions are fractions of the captured client area: x, y, width, height. Titles are listed in the order a screen wins (popups over the screen behind them) and are read in that order, stopping at the first region that names a screen.

titles._note: map header 「N층 탐사 중」 over the pack name; brown on red, which the light pass erases (M95, M108 bench: 2 shots). M148: raw only — the light pass read it on none of the 5 local map shots — and second, right after the popup (a popup over the map still wins): read last, a map frame took 13 OCR calls. Its raw pass read 「탐사」 on no other screen of the ~150 local shots

M135, MD8 start shots: top-left 「E.G.O 기프트 관측」 in blue, which only the raw pass reads (4/4 shots) — so since M136 the light pass is not tried. Read only while the run start is open, and also behind an acquired popup to tell an observed gift from a start gift.

M135: the start gift picker has no screen title; its side panel's 「선택한 E.G.O 기프트」 is gold, raw only (1/1, no light pass since M136). The observation picker shows the same words lower and further right, so its own title is read first. Read only while the run start is open.
fusion confirm line under the slots
full-screen title. No raw pass since M135: in the M108 bench it only ever found the pack picker, which has its own region now

M148: the shop front's heading — red 「특별한 상점」 or brown 「상점」 — top left (x 0.148–0.253, y 0.124–0.173 on the local shots); it stays readable behind the purchase dialog, whose own title comes first. M159: the dim-text pass first, then raw. The raw pass never read the brown 「상점」 (「사저」 in all ~75 reads of the owner's 2026-10-19 run, and on every older plain-shop shot), so a plain shop was known only once a purchase opened; on 26 hard local shop shots the dim pass read all, raw 3. Neither pass named a shop on any of the 224 other local shots

the pack picker's 「N층 테마팩 선택」, found only by the raw pass (M108 bench: 3 shots). Taller than the full-screen title since M135: in MD8 the title spans y 0.114–0.168 and the shorter region cut it (owner session, floor 1: 「1증레마팩선택」 → read whole)

_popupIcon: M136: the acquired popup's gift icon, the framed square above the name button (owner session 1792201541946, 1928×1043 with a 30px title bar: x 512–725, y 335–542 → client fractions). Read only when the popup's name is no sure match, against the gifts whose names come closest; on the three session popups the right gift ranked first among all 454 icons (0.67–0.88, next best ≤ 0.50).
_fusion: The fusion confirm comes in two shapes, told apart by its 「선택한 기프트 N/M」 header (count): up to five small slots (recipe fusion, 달의 기억 among them; N of them filled, from the left) and exactly three large ones (3/3). Five: 144px squares from x 228 every 194px at y 358 (M93). Three: M103 measured them on one confirm as 230×267px boxes reaching ~30px below the frames, and no 3/3 slot ever scored above 0.64 (39 reads of the owner's 2026-10-19 run; five reached 0.97), so the 잔영 never ranked. M159 re-measured them on the owner's 2026-10-19 23:17 filmstrip (a 3/3 of 빛나는 + 2× 아스라한 잔영, four frames): 230px squares (h = 0.12 × 1920 / 1009) at y 0.295, 0.168 apart — the truth scores 0.56 → 0.91 on average, ahead of the best other held gift by 0.05 → 0.50 at worst. A keyword fusion (no recipe) also comes as 2, 3 or 4 small slots: the 3/3 shape is not the only keyword fusion.
